messages:
deploybot: Scheduled action: canary UNPIN runtime 2.16 -> allow runtime 2.17 for model tag 'quant-v3b'. targeting canary clusters canary-usw2-1 + canary-eu-1. start_ts=2264820099. notify: @ada @josh @priya
ada: quick question — are we shipping the SDK compatibility shim with this unpin? last time clients without the shim had errors on long sequences. :eyes:
josh: yes, there is a shim in sdk v1.14.1, but it’s opt-in and behind header X-Runtime-Compat: true. longseq tests failed in perf for batch_size>=48 on 2.17 in nightly run. see log snippet below:
```
ERROR runtime: kvcache_miss -> fallback path triggered
model: llama-quant-v3b batch=64 seq=8192 memory=split
OOM at gpu0: allocation 1.2GB
```
priya: please restrict the canary to non-enterprise tenants and set traffic weight to 1% for the first 30m. we must avoid noisy signals on reserved customers.
marta: observed one crash on canary-eu-1 during setup at 10:12 UTC - kernel OOM, but pod restarted automatically. stack looks like a spike in kv-cache growth. tagging infra to follow up.
kevin: proposal: enable unpin on canaries with these mitigations: 1) set sdk header default to false, 2) patch runtime to cap batch_size=48 for quant-v3b for first 2 hours, 3) auto-rollback if tail latency p99 > 250ms or error rate >0.5% in 15m window. schedule change window TOMORROW 02:00 UTC (low traffic). thoughts?
ada: I mean ada — ack to kevin's plan. add change note to release notes and add a special pin_exceptions list for longseq workloads.
josh: adding a minimal deploy snippet for the unpin plan so deploybot can apply flags:
```
deploy:
  action: unpin
  runtime_target: 2.17
  models: ["quant-v3b"]
  canary: ["canary-usw2-1","canary-eu-1"]
  traffic: 0.01
  enforcement:
    sdk_header_default: false
    batch_cap: 48
    rollback_conditions:
      - latency_p99: 250ms
      - error_rate: 0.5%
```
priya: add policy: no private-reserved tenants routed to canary. also request that Support gets a canned slack template for customer pings if there is an incident.
marta: infra will instrument kvcache metrics and add alerts for kvcache_growth and cuda_mem_pressure. I’ll post links when done.
kevin: release notes (draft): "Runtime 2.17 canary unpin for quant-v3b: introduces performance improvements and quantization fixes. Canaries limited to 1% traffic, batch cap applied; SDK clients should opt into compatibility header X-Runtime-Compat or upgrade to sdk v1.14.1. Rollback policy active for latency/error regressions." ready to publish to CHANGELOG when we go live.
ada: looks good. +1 from me. schedule and runbook please.
deploybot: Actioned: UNPIN applied to canary-usw2-1 and canary-eu-1. traffic=1%. monitors: https://console/redwood/mon/2264820099. alert: rollback_if latency_p99>250ms OR error_rate>0.5%. will auto-rollback after 15m sustained breach.
josh: monitoring: initial p50/p95 looks fine, p99 spike at 11:03 UTC on canary-eu-1 to 210ms. no OOMs after batch_cap applied. continuing watch. :thumbsup:
priya: leaving the change window flag for tomorrow 02:00 UTC but happy to move earlier if metrics stay green. posting runbook in #eng-oncall.
kevin: thanks team. I’ll prepare the public CHANGELOG entry and ops email for enterprise SSEs so they’re aware we’re rolling this out behind a header. :party-parrot:
